tiles.note: The southern entry to Millhaven. Wooden palisade walls frame the road.
The southern entry to Millhaven. A weathered signpost reads 'Millhaven'.
A modest stable where travellers can board or rent horses.
A dirt road leading into town.
The main tavern of Millhaven. A warm glow spills from the windows.

args.message: The party arrives in Millhaven. The Crossed Antlers tavern stands before you, its sign creaking in the wind. A notice board by the door is covered in postings.

zones.label: Entrance
zones.description: Heavy oak doors open into the warmth of the tavern. The smell of roasting meat and woodsmoke fills the air.

zones.label: Main Hall
zones.description: A smoky common room with low beams. The fire crackles in the hearth. Several patrons nurse their drinks at rough-hewn tables.

greeting: Welcome to the Crossed Antlers. What'll it be?
Another brave soul looking for work, eh?
shop: Ale's two coppers, stew's five. Best in Millhaven.
quest: You've seen the notice board? That blight's killing us.
Captain Aldric posted that bounty himself. He's at the guard post.
Talk to Edda if you want to know how bad it really is.
lore: Strange folk been passing through lately. City types.
The forest wasn't always this way. Started a few months back.
farewell: Safe travels. And come back alive, yeah?

greeting: Oh, thank the gods. Are you the ones answering the bounty?
quest: My fields are dying. The crops turn black overnight.
It started when that purple haze crept out of the forest.
Please, you have to stop whatever's causing this.
lore: My grandmother told stories of the old citadel. Nothing good.
She said a king once ruled from there. A cruel one.
farewell: Be careful out there. The forest isn't what it used to be.

voice_profile.pitch_description: Quick, sly voice with a slight rasp

greeting: Voss has what you need. For a price.
shop: Healing potions, rope, torches — basics, basics.
I might have something rarer, if you've got the coin.
quest: The forest? I know paths even the druids forgot.
Information isn't free, friend. Fifty gold and I'll mark your map.
lore: Seen some guild types heading north. Ashenmere money.
Word is something valuable is buried in that old citadel.
farewell: Pleasure doing business. Or not. Your loss.

lore: BOUNTY POSTED: A blight spreads from the Thornveil Forest. Reward offered for eliminating the source. Report to Captain Aldric at the Guard Post for details and authorization.

zones.label: Back Room
zones.description: A cramped storeroom with barrels stacked to the ceiling. A trapdoor in the floor catches your eye.

tiles.note: A short lane with merchant stalls.
Basic adventuring supplies at fair prices.
The central gathering area of Millhaven. A well stands in the centre.
Captain Aldric's headquarters. A sturdy stone building.

zones.label: Guard Post
zones.description: A sturdy stone building with weapon racks on the walls. A large map of the region is pinned behind the captain's desk.

greeting: You here about the blight bounty?
quest: The Thornveil is off limits normally. Wolves, worse.
But this blight is spreading. Fields are dying.
Take this writ. Show it at the forest gate.
Something's driving the beasts mad. Be ready for a fight.
lore: Old Valdris citadel is deep in the forest. Abandoned for centuries.
Whatever's causing this, it's coming from that direction.
farewell: Bring proof you've dealt with the source, and the reward is yours.

greeting: Looking for the captain? He's inside.
quest: Captain's been posting bounties all week. The blight's got everyone on edge.

lore: A large map of the region pinned behind the captain's desk. The Thornveil Forest is marked with red ink. An arrow points north toward the Valdris Citadel with the note: 'Source?'

tiles.note: A small chapel dedicated to the harvest gods.
The road north out of Millhaven, toward the Thornveil Forest.
The tree line begins. Sunlight still filters through healthy canopy.
Torn earth and claw marks. The wolves here are not behaving normally.

args.message: Four wolves emerge from the undergrowth, their eyes wild and tinged with purple. They attack without hesitation. Roll initiative!

tiles.note: A narrow trail winding through the trees.
An ancient shrine half-swallowed by roots. Inscriptions remain legible.

args.message: A ruined shrine stands among the trees. An inscription on the central stone reads: 'I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish. What am I?' (Answer: A map)
You notice a loose stone at the base of the shrine. Behind it: a Potion of Healing and 15 gold pieces.

tiles.note: The path continues north. The trees grow darker.
A small clearing with standing stones. Faint runes glow on the rocks.

zones.label: Druid's Clearing
zones.description: A small clearing where the blight hasn't fully taken hold. Faintly glowing runes are carved into the standing stones. A figure in tattered green robes leans against the largest stone.

voice_profile.pitch_description: Airy, fading voice — a dying druid

greeting: You... you shouldn't be here. The forest is dying.
quest: The corruption flows from the old Valdris citadel.
But it didn't start on its own. Someone brought something there.
Something that was never meant to be worn.
A crown. An ancient, terrible crown.
lore: I've been trying to hold back the blight. But I'm failing.
The wards I placed are crumbling. Whatever powers the Crown grows stronger.
If you go to Valdris, look for the chapel. It's the one place the Crown's influence hasn't reached.
farewell: Go. Stop this. Before there's nothing left to save.

tiles.note: A rope bridge spans a shallow ravine. The planks look questionable.

args.message: You notice the bridge planks are partially sawn through. You can cross carefully (DEX check) or find another way.
The crash attracts two giant spiders from beneath the bridge! Roll initiative!

tiles.note: Thick brambles. Movement here is slow.
The trees are blackened. A faint purple haze hangs in the air.
Blighted trees creak ominously. Dead animals litter the ground.
The corruption is thick here. Even the soil feels wrong.
Open pastureland stretching to the horizon.
Old Renn tends his dwindling flock here. A safe place to rest.

greeting: Travellers, eh? Haven't seen many this way lately.
quest: The sheep won't graze near the forest edge anymore.
Smart animals. Smarter than some folk.
lore: Seen riders from Ashenmere heading north. Guild banners.
Something's rotten in that city. Mark my words.
farewell: Watch the skies. And the ground, for that matter.

tiles.note: Grassland dotted with wildflowers. Peaceful, for now.
The grass thins toward Ashenmere. Wagon ruts mark the road.
The western edge of Ashenmere. Low buildings, laundry lines.
Modest homes and workshops.
The main southern entrance to Ashenmere. Guards check travellers.
A cobbled road leads into the city centre.
Eastern residential district.
The city wall curves northeast.
Quiet streets. Shuttered windows.
Stalls and shops line a wide avenue.
The main thoroughfare of Ashenmere. Busy with foot traffic.
A large fountain at the city's crossroads.
Wealthy merchant establishments.
Quiet residential area near the eastern wall.
A tall stone building filled with ancient texts.

zones.label: Reading Room
zones.description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves packed with scrolls and books. Dust motes dance in the light from tall windows. The archivist hunches over a massive tome.

greeting: The archive is open for research. Please be quiet.
quest: The Hollow Crown? Yes, I've found references.
An artefact of the old kingdom. It was supposed to be destroyed.
Someone has been asking about it. Someone from the guild.
lore: The Crown was forged to bind the land to the ruler's will.
But it corrupts. Every king who wore it went mad.
The last one — they called him the Hollow King — nearly destroyed everything.
farewell: Be careful with this knowledge. Some people don't want it shared.

zones.label: Restricted Vault
zones.description: Ancient texts behind iron bars. One shelf holds a leather-bound book with the royal seal of the old kingdom.

lore: A leather-bound book with the royal seal of the old kingdom. It chronicles the forging of the Hollow Crown and each ruler who wore it. Every entry ends the same way: madness, then ruin.

tiles.note: An opulent hall displaying Ashenmere's wealth.

zones.label: Guild Hall
zones.description: Opulent marble floors, gilded columns. The wealth of Ashenmere is on full display. Merchants and clerks bustle between offices.

zones.label: Guildmaster's Office
zones.description: A private office with heavy curtains and a locked desk. Maps on the wall show trade routes — and one marked path leading to the Thornveil Forest.

voice_profile.pitch_description: Commanding, smooth — hides cruelty behind politeness

greeting: Adventurers. How fortunate. I have a proposition.
shop: The manticore bounty pays 200 gold. Generous, no?
quest: A Razorclaw Manticore on the east road. Killing our caravans.
Deal with it and the guild will remember your service.
lore: Valdris? Ancient ruin. Nothing of interest.
The blight is a natural phenomenon. It will pass.
combat: You think you can threaten ME? In MY city?

lore: A heavy oak desk with an iron lock. Inside: ledgers showing large payments to 'L.C.M.' and a wax-sealed letter referencing 'the Crown ritual'.
Maps on the wall show standard trade routes — and one marked path leading deep into the Thornveil Forest, circled in red ink. The destination is labelled 'V.C.'

tiles.note: Ashenmere's finest inn. Good food, warm beds, cold ale.

zones.label: Common Room
zones.description: A bustling inn with a roaring fireplace. The smell of roasted meat and fresh bread fills the air. Travellers and locals share tables and stories.

greeting: Welcome to the Iron Flagon! Best beds in Ashenmere.
shop: Room's ten silver a night. Includes breakfast.
We've got ale, wine, and something stronger if you need it.
lore: The guildmaster's been throwing money around lately.
Hiring mercenaries, buying supplies. For what, nobody knows.
farewell: Rest well. You look like you need it.

tiles.note: The city guard's headquarters. Well-armed soldiers patrol.

zones.label: Barracks
zones.description: Rows of bunks and weapon racks. City guards sharpen blades and play dice. The commander watches from a raised platform.

quest: The city is safe. That's all you need to know.
If you have a complaint, file it with the clerk.
lore: The guildmaster is a respected citizen. I'd watch your tongue.
farewell: Don't cause trouble in my city.

tiles.note: The northern city wall. A gate leads toward Valdris.
Fortified wall segment.
The gate toward the Valdris road. A manticore was spotted nearby.

args.message: A massive manticore swoops from a rocky outcropping east of the road, its tail barbs already raised! Roll initiative!

tiles.note: A road east of the gate. A courier lies dead in the rocks.

voice_profile.pitch_description: Young woman — found dead on the road

lore: (A courier's satchel lies beside the body. The seal on the letter bears a crown entwined with thorns.)

The letter reads: 'Lord Castellan — The Crown is nearly attuned. The forest will be ours within the month. Continue the ritual. The guild's resources are at your disposal. — T.' (The letter is signed with a single 'T' — Torven.)

args.message: You find a courier's body half-hidden in the rocks beside the road. A sealed letter in her satchel bears a crown entwined with thorns.

tiles.note: Fortified wall segment.
The northeast corner of the city wall.
The road north. Trees are dead. The ground is grey.
A hasty campsite. Someone fled here recently.

greeting: Don't — don't attack! I'm not with them anymore.
quest: I was guild muscle. Torven sent us to guard the citadel.
But what's in there... it's not natural. I ran.
The main hall is trapped. Use the side corridor if you value your skin.
lore: There's a man in there. Calls himself Lord Castellan.
The Crown is doing something to him. He's not... right.
The chapel is safe though. Old wards still hold.
farewell: I'm heading south. Far south. Good luck.

tiles.note: A blighted clearing. Something stirs in the dead earth.

args.message: A figure in rusted armour rises from the blighted ground. The Fallen Knight's eyes burn with cold fire. Roll initiative!

tiles.note: The road ends at a looming fortress.
Crumbling walls visible ahead. The air hums with power.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
The western side of the shattered entry hall.
The main entrance. Massive doors hang from broken hinges.
The eastern side of the entry hall.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Trapped corridors winding deeper into the citadel.

args.message: You spot a pressure plate just in time and step around it.

zones.label: Entry Corridor
zones.description: Crumbling stone walls covered in blackened vines. The air tastes of rot. Pressure plates are barely visible beneath the dust.

zones.label: Deep Corridor
zones.description: The vines are thicker here, pulsing with a faint purple light. The walls seem to breathe.

tiles.note: Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
A ransacked laboratory. Some potions remain intact.
An old armoury. A sword glows faintly in an alcove.

lore: A finely crafted longsword rests in a stone alcove. It glows faintly when brought near the throne room.

tiles.note: Barracks. Corrupted soldiers wait in silence.

args.message: You dodge the poison darts shooting from the walls!

zones.label: Guard Quarters
zones.description: Bunks and weapon racks. Three soldiers sit in unnatural stillness, their eyes glowing faintly purple. They don't react until you enter.

lore: Battered weapon racks line the walls. Most weapons are rusted, but one shield still gleams — enchanted, perhaps.

tiles.note: Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
A safe haven. The Crown's corruption cannot reach here.

args.message: The ward stone glows with warm light. The oppressive atmosphere lifts. You feel safe here — this is a place of rest, protected from the Crown's influence. You may take a long rest.

zones.label: Chapel
zones.description: A small chapel bathed in warm light. The oppressive atmosphere of the citadel doesn't reach here. Ancient protective runes glow softly on the walls.

lore: A smooth white stone set into the chapel floor, engraved with protective runes. It hums with warm energy.

tiles.note: The heart of the citadel. The Hollow Crown pulses with dark energy. BOSS ENCOUNTER.

greeting: Ah. More insects come to challenge the inevitable.
combat: The Crown is mine! The forest, the land — ALL MINE!
You cannot stop what has already begun!
KNEEL before the true ruler of these lands!
The blight is just the beginning.
lore: Torven was a fool. A useful one, but a fool nonetheless.
The Crown chose ME. Do you understand? It called to me across centuries.

args.message: Lord Castellan Morvain sits on the ancient throne, the Hollow Crown pulsing with dark energy on his brow. Thorned vines spread from the Crown across the chamber floor. He rises slowly. 'Ah. More insects come to challenge the inevitable.' Roll initiative!

tiles.note: Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
Massive stone walls, impenetrable.
